poisson_equals_pooled_sample_log_odds.consequence: A second baseline named pooled log odds would be identical and is not reported.
poisson_equals_pooled_sample_log_odds.derivation: Saturation makes the four fitted means equal the four pooled counts; the interaction contrast log(mu00)+log(mu11)-log(mu01)-log(mu10) therefore has the stated closed form.
poisson_equals_pooled_sample_log_odds.statement: For a positive pooled 2x2 table, the row-by-column coefficient of the saturated Poisson log-linear model is log(N00*N11/(N01*N10)).

poisson_is_not_the_stratified_exact_cmle.pooled_poisson_score: beta = log((sum_d n_d00)(sum_d n_d11)/((sum_d n_d01)(sum_d n_d10)))
poisson_is_not_the_stratified_exact_cmle.statement: Pooling removes donor-specific margins. The exact CMLE instead solves a sum of donor-conditional expectation equations, so the estimates are not generally equal.

inference.sign_test: exact one-sided binomial; zero differences are nonfavorable

methods.common_effect_exact_cmle: One unpenalized common log odds per RNA--ADT pair, maximizing the product of donor-specific exact fixed-margin likelihoods.
methods.loss: The original study-specific mean Poisson deviance per cell over informative RNA--ADT pairs.
methods.pooled_poisson_loglinear_interaction: One saturated Poisson row-by-column interaction per RNA--ADT pair after summing source tables across donors.
methods.primary: Existing frozen held predictions from the donor-heterogeneity-aware penalized composite exact conditional estimator.
methods.reconstruction: Every finite field is multiplied by a development-selected alpha and converted to the noncentral-hypergeometric expected table at the frozen held donor margins.

reason_post_hoc: Both held outcome panels had already been accessed before these baseline definitions and comparisons were executed.
